h: Lagos seals four churches over noise pollution
p: The Lagos State Environmental Protection Agency has sealed four churches in Ajah and Ipaja-Ayobo for persistent noise pollution. The agency said the enforcement was carried out on Tuesday.
body: The Lagos State Environmental Protection Agency (LASEPA) has sealed four churches over persistent noise pollution.

The agency said on its X account on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, that the enforcement was carried out on Tuesday. The affected churches are a Celestial Church of Christ parish in Lambada, Ajah; a branch of The Lord's Chosen Charismatic Revival Movement in Ipaja-Ayobo; God's Word Faith Ministries in Ipaja-Ayobo; and His Presence Redemptions Ministry International, also in Ipaja-Ayobo.
LASEPA said the churches were sealed for persistent noise pollution, in line with the state's environmental laws.
more: Four churches were sealed on Tuesday.
Three are in Ipaja-Ayobo and one in Ajah.
